title: Instinct vs ChatGPT Dots: Two AI Agents in Your iMessage Thread
summary: Instinct and ChatGPT dots both live in iMessage now. Compare access, cost, channels, group chats, privacy and who each agent fits, with sources.
body_markdown:
Dimension Instinct ChatGPT dots (texting)


Who makes it Spear Street Technology, Inc. d/b/a Instinct, San Francisco ([Built In](https://builtin.com/articles/instinct-ai) ) OpenAI


How you reach it iMessage, WhatsApp or email, no app ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1008254/instinct-agent-ai-hands-on-muse-dots) ,[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/i-finally-found-an-ai-agent-worth-the-risk/) ) iMessage on iPhone or RCS on Android, plus the ChatGPT app, web, Slack and Teams ([OpenAI](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots/channels) )


Is texting the main way in? Yes, texting is the product No, it's one added channel, with the same memory and plugins everywhere


Who can use it Invited beta users ChatGPT Pro users 18+ in the U.S., limited beta rolling out gradually ([OpenAI Help Center](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001530-getting-started-with-your-dot) )


Price today Free for invited beta users, no public price; terms reserve the right to charge fees ([eesel](https://www.eesel.ai/blog/instinct-ai-review) ) Included with ChatGPT Pro ($100, $200 or $500 a month); first dot included ([OpenAI](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9793128-about-chatgpt-pro-tiers) )


Group chats Yes, announced Oct 5, 2026; friends don't need an account ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/05/instinct-brings-its-ai-agent-to-group-chats-even-for-friends-without-an-account/) ) No, one-to-one only


Approvals In group chats, it asks before sharing or acting (TechCrunch) Actions that need approval arrive as a link that opens in ChatGPT


Integrations Google Workspace, Slack, Notion and a secure vault (The Verge); Zocdoc booking rolling out ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/zocdoc-brings-seamless-real-time-appointment-booking-to-instinct-302922808.html) ) The same plugins and tools you set up for your dot in ChatGPT


Model Not disclosed; uses unnamed third-party model providers ([Instinct privacy policy](https://instinct.com/privacy-policy) ) GPT-6 Astra ([OpenAI release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) )


Your data Trains on your data by default, opt-out applies going forward; can store payment cards and third-party passwords (Instinct privacy policy) Texting doesn't give your dot or OpenAI access to your other conversations (OpenAI)


Who it fits People who want a personal errand assistant inside their texts and can wait for an invite ChatGPT Pro users in the U.S. who want to reach the agent they already use for work from their phone
